notes: Taḥwīl «ح» after «حدثنا ليث»: the branches meet at Layth, so the names after the second Layth are the shared tail
«أبي معبد، مولى ابن عباس» is one man (kunya, comma, client descriptor); the Companion is the second «ابن عباس» in the text
«وقال لم يزل رسول الله يلبي» continues the same report with no new isnad; no group added
